# Bharat Relocators

> Bharat Relocators is a premier relocation and logistics service headquartered at Haltu, Kolkata, providing residential moving, vehicle transportation, corporate office relocation, international moving, and express parcel shipping across Kolkata, West Bengal, and nationwide PAN-India corridors.

## Commercial Services

- Household Shifting (/household-shifting): Residential moving, multi-layer packing, carpenter furniture assembly/dismantling, and local/intercity home relocation.
- Car Transportation (/car-shifting): Enclosed hydraulic ramp multi-car carriers for damage-free vehicle shipping from Kolkata to major Indian metros.
- Bike Transport (/bike-shifting): Specialized two-wheeler logistics with 3-layer bubble/foam packing and custom wooden crating.
- Office Relocation (/office-relocation): Phased commercial office shifting, server/IT equipment handling, modular workstation relocation, and archive moving.
- International Moving (/international-moving): Cross-border household relocation, export-grade seaworthy/airworthy packing, and customs clearance advisory.
- Parcel & Cargo Shifting (/parcel-shifting): Intercity luggage, student personal effects, small cargo, and boxed consignment transport with doorstep pickup and delivery.

## Resource Hub & Educational Guides

- Moving Guides Resource Hub (/moving-guides): Central resource directory organizing comprehensive moving checklists, vehicle shipping advice, and intercity route logistics.
- Comprehensive Moving Checklist (/moving-checklist): Complete 4-week step-by-step moving preparation checklist and inventory planning framework.
- Vehicle Transportation Guide (/vehicle-transportation-guide): In-depth guide on carrier types, vehicle preparation checklist, and transit insurance options.
- Intercity Moving & Corridor Guide (/intercity-moving-guide): Route insights, toll/checkpost considerations, and intercity timeline planning from Kolkata.

- Head Office: 17, Ramlal Bazar Rd, Ramlal Bazar, Haltu, Kolkata, West Bengal 700078, India
- Primary Service Hub: Kolkata Metropolitan Area (including Haltu, Behala, Salt Lake, New Town, Jadavpur, Garia, Ballygunge, Alipore, Rajarhat, Howrah)
- Pan-India Corridors: Kolkata ⇄ Delhi NCR, Mumbai/Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Bhubaneswar, Siliguri, Guwahati, Patna, Ranchi.
